name: Refia
description: Paala's younger sister, who tends manul kittens and wants to take their mother's job.

description_citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story
description_citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Paala dreams of the night her family's caravan was attacked and her mother fled with her and the baby Refia.
timeline.quote: Paala only running, running, running from a danger she didn't understand

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Paala wakes in the manul tent on the night before the Lightning Proving, teasing with Refia.
timeline.quote: Paala woke with a gasp, sitting bolt upright in the bedding, sending pillows and kittens flying.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Mardu: Where Lightning Tells Our Story" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Paala remembers how a Mardu hunting party found her family and took them in, and how her mother came to tend their manul kittens.
timeline.quote: a Mardu hunting party that had been tasked with scouting and following the storm had stumbled across the three of them

timeline.summary: Refia brings Paala a yearling manul for the trial and urges her to catch a big bolt.
